note: Forest County park on 2,100-acre Lake Metonga, about 4 miles south of Crandon. Open grassy loop with sandy swim beach, boat launch and pavilions; a lakeshore road runs between the loop and the water. Sites 1-19 are rented by the season, sites 20-58 by the night. ATVs and UTVs are not allowed in the campground. --Claude
summary: County page (2027 season), site map, park rules PDF, booking engine, Google and imagery read. Lakeview KEPT: the north row (sites ~22-27) is ~15-25 m from the shore over open grass, but the county map shows a lakeshore road between the loop and the water (and the swim beach at the west end). Fees $35 + $10 confirmed; 14-night max; season May 1-Oct 1 2027. Count 58 -> 65 (19 seasonal + 39 camper + 7 tent); nightly share 46/65 (71%). max_rig_ft 60 unsourced on the county pages.
flags: Lakeview KEPT (no --AWH value): Esri imagery shows the loop's north row of pads (map sites ~19-27, around 45.5220,-88.8995) on open lawn ~15-25 m from the shore with a single line of scattered trees, but the county site map draws the park road to the tent-site parking along the shore between those sites and the lake ('a loop road in the way means *view at best'); the west end is the swim beach (day use). No upgrade.

Count 58 -> 65: seasonal sites 1-19 ($2,100 a season, waiting list), camper sites 20-58 (39, nightly), tent-only T1-T7. 46 of 65 sites (71%) are sold by the night - fine for a county park, no seasonal caveat needed, but the note says which sites are seasonal.
